data.one_liner: Applies linear, radial, and sweep gradient effects to Flutter icons.
data.what_it_does: Provides a GradientIcon widget that allows developers to easily apply customizable gradient effects to standard icons. Supports control over colors, directions, and various gradient types like linear, radial, and sweep.
use_when: You need to display icons styled with custom gradients instead of a solid color.
You want support for linear, radial, and sweep gradients on your UI icons.
avoid_when: You only need standard single-color icons supported natively by Icon.
strengths: Supports multiple gradient types including linear, radial, and sweep gradients.
Extremely simple API focused entirely on gradient icons.
weaknesses: Very narrow scope limited strictly to icons with gradients.
